name: The Weight of Floating
source:
You're in your garden. It is a warm summer's day. A large bubble has formed around you.

Stay in the bubble and see where it takes you, or pop it at any time.

[From [url=https://conway-sutton.itch.io/the-weight-of-floating]itch.io[/url]]
